_note: Declaration for scripts/check_prompt_layers.py. L0/L1/L2 prompt text and MCP tool descriptions are PLATFORM text: every installation and every user receives them, so they may carry only generalized product doctrine. Every fact this checker knows is in this file, not in the script.

surfaces.why: L0 PLATFORM_KERNEL, the role/agent preambles, the runtime briefing, and every L2 persona
L2 for runner apps that declare a chat in their manifest
MCP tool names/descriptions/schemas reach the model identically to L2
the page tools' names, descriptions and schemas on the workshop tool server
chat_access, the tool a chat uses to see and change its own access
the operation verbs (app_status, app_logs, app_control) on the workshop tool server
the per-turn PAGE AND APPS block a chat beside a page or with granted apps receives
the ticket distiller; the rest of this module is route code, not prompt text
the working-state fold; the rest of this module schedules and stores it
the SessionStart context a turn with a shell is given about how deleting works there
the reasons the policy hook gives the model when it refuses or asks about a delete

gendered-pronoun.fix: platform text does not know the reader's or the operator's pronouns; write 'they' or name the role

host-path.fix: one host's filesystem layout; resolve it at runtime (wsplatform.paths) or declare it in the installation config

doc-filename.fix: a doc path is a fact about one checkout; put it in that repo's AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md, or take the name from the module that owns the file

vendor-name.fix: name the capability, not the vendor; declare the vendor in the installation config (services/installation.py)
